citation.note: Payroll record retention (A.R.S. § 23-364): employers must keep payroll records showing daily hours worked, wages, overtime pay, earned paid sick time accrual and use, and pay rates for at least 4 years; employees may inspect and copy their own records.

Paid sick leave (A.R.S. § 23-371 et seq.): employees accrue 1 hour per 30 hours worked, capped at 40 hours/year (15+ employees) or 24 hours/year (<15 employees); usable after 90 days; carryover up to 40 hours; rehire within 9 months restores the balance.

body.interaction_rule: Paid sick leave (A.R.S. § 23-371 et seq.): employees accrue 1 hour per 30 hours worked, capped at 40 hours/year (15+ employees) or 24 hours/year (<15 employees); usable after 90 days; carryover up to 40 hours; rehire within 9 months restores the balance.

citation.note: Pay frequency (A.R.S. § 23-351): employers must designate two or more paydays per month, not more than 16 days apart; regular wages paid within 5 business days after the pay period ends.

Final pay on discharge (A.R.S. § 23-353): wages due within 7 working days or by the end of the next regular payday, whichever is sooner; resignation wages due by the regular payday for the period of termination.

citation.note: E-Verify mandate (A.R.S. § 23-214, Legal Arizona Workers Act): all Arizona employers regardless of size must verify new hires through E-Verify; keep records for employment duration or 3 years; violations risk license suspension or revocation.

citation.note: Minimum wage (A.R.S. § 23-363, Prop. 206): $15.15/hour statewide (2026), adjusted annually for CPI-U inflation; Flagstaff $18.35/hour (no tip credit) and Tucson $15.45/hour ($3.00 tip credit) attach as locality-level overlays.
Pay statement content: no detailed state requirement; employers must maintain records showing daily hours worked, pay rates, and earned paid sick time accrual and use (A.R.S. § 23-364).
Use of earned paid sick time is protected from retaliation and cannot trigger adverse action; flag pay reductions during or within 30 days of sick-leave use (A.R.S. § 23-373).
At-will employment: Arizona recognizes pure at-will employment; termination requires no advance notice unless a written contract specifies otherwise (A.R.S. § 23-1501).

Drug and alcohol testing permitted with an advance written policy stating circumstances and substances tested (A.R.S. § 23-493.04); registered medical-marijuana cardholders protected unless impaired or on-premises use (A.R.S. § 36-2813).

Data breach notification (A.R.S. §§ 18-551–552): entities must notify Arizona residents of breaches exposing personal information, including biometric data coupled with name, within 45 days and without unreasonable delay.
